title: Unintended token minting to staking address when fee rate is 0
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When adding liquidity to the pool, the contract calls `_calculateSupply` twice. The difference between the two results is minted to the staking address as mint fees. However, when the fee rate is set to 0, pool tokens are still minted to the staking address, resulting in an unexpected loss for liquidity providers.  This issue arises because the first call to `_calculateSupply` rounds down, while the second call rounds up.
